en: The postcard shows a historic square with a large pavilion or bandstand in the center, surrounded by benches, trimmed trees, and old European buildings. A church with a high spire is visible in the background. The text at the top of the image reads 'Bad Pyrmont Hauptbrunnen mit Brunnenplatz.' The reverse of the postcard is divided and features the stamp of a local museum, 'MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'.
